title: Hexcassettes (Forge Fork)
description: Hexcassettes (Forge Fork) — an unofficial Forge port of the original Hexcassettes mod. Adds delayed hex execution and experimental automation features. May contain bugs and unfinished features.
body:
Hexcassettes (Forge Fork) is a Forge fork of the original Hexcassettes mod.

It adds a way to delay hexes into the future, with a touch of playfulness and whimsy.

You can also use it to:

pass data between hexes
display information through the user interface
create passive or repeating effects
experiment with unusual automation behavior
This fork is unofficial and may contain:

bugs
unfinished features
experimental changes
behavior that differs from the original mod
